3\.

The data giving the amount spent on advertising and the sales volume in the first month of 8 new products are given below

+----------------+--------------------------+--------------------+
| Product number | X Advertising (\$10,000) | Y                  |
|                |                          |                    |
|                |                          | Sales (1000 units) |
+:==============:+:========================:+:==================:+
| 1              | 50                       | 157                |
+----------------+--------------------------+--------------------+
| 2              | 25                       | 152                |
+----------------+--------------------------+--------------------+
| 3              | 21                       | 69                 |
+----------------+--------------------------+--------------------+
| 4              | 65                       | 218                |
+----------------+--------------------------+--------------------+
| 5              | 30                       | 134                |
+----------------+--------------------------+--------------------+
| 6              | 40                       | 173                |
+----------------+--------------------------+--------------------+
| 7              | 25                       | 81                 |
+----------------+--------------------------+--------------------+
| 8              | 40                       | 113                |
+----------------+--------------------------+--------------------+

a)  Fit the least squares line that expresses sales in terms of advertising.

b)  Predict the level of sales when \$350,000 is spent on advertising.

c)  Find correlation coefficient for the data.

Solution: a) The least squares line is y=38.592+2.663x.

b\) When x=35, y=131.797.

c\) The correlation coefficient for the data is r=0.812.
